values.manifest:
mikroscope-manifest=1
name=mikroscope
tag=mikroscope:mikroscope (managed by mikroscope)
disk=
veth=veth-mikroscope
subnet=172.30.10.0/30
port=9123
iface-list=LAN
addr-list=LANs
expose=192.168.88.1
container-name=
remote-image=registry-1.docker.io/jmrplens/mikroscope-agent:{{MIKROSCOPE_VERSION}}
token=yes
dir=mikroscope
file=mikroscope/mikroscope.manifest.txt
object=/interface/veth name=veth-mikroscope
object=/ip/address interface=veth-mikroscope
object=/interface/list/member interface=veth-mikroscope list=LAN
object=/ip/firewall/address-list list=LANs address=172.30.10.0/30
object=/ip/firewall/nat chain=dstnat dst-address=192.168.88.1 dst-port=9123 protocol=tcp
object=/ip/firewall/filter chain=forward dst-address=172.30.10.2 dst-port=9123 protocol=tcp
object=/container/envs list=mikroscope-env
object=/container interface=veth-mikroscope
dir=mikroscope/mikroscope
values.name: mikroscope

note: a token without exposure; the token is a fixed fake
